privacy.consentDescription: Bubbles works without optional tracking. Analytics and advertising stay off unless you choose to enable them.
privacy.consentDescriptionNoAds: Bubbles works without optional tracking. Usage analytics stays off unless you choose to enable it, and advertising is disabled in this build.
privacy.settingsDescription: Choose which optional services Bubbles may load. Essential storage keeps your language, session and preferences working.
privacy.settingsDescriptionNoAds: Choose whether Bubbles may load optional usage analytics. Advertising is disabled in this build. Essential storage keeps your language, session and preferences working.
privacy.essentialDescription: Required for sign-in, multiplayer sessions, language and saved preferences. These do not load Google Analytics or AdSense.
privacy.analyticsDescription: Allows Google Analytics to measure page visits and feature usage so we can improve Bubbles.
privacy.advertisingDescription: Allows Google AdSense to load and display ads. Google may process device and interaction data for this purpose.
privacy.storageNote: Your choice is saved in this browser and can be changed at any time.

privacyNotice.introduction: This notice describes the data and browser storage used by this version of Bubbles, including which third-party services are optional.
privacyNotice.essentialSession: For multiplayer, the browser creates a random session identifier and exchanges your display name, room presence, bubble actions and cursor positions with the service and other participants in the room.
privacyNotice.essentialAccount: If you sign in, the browser stores an authentication token in local storage and sends it with Bubbles API and WebSocket requests so the service can recognize the signed-in account.
privacyNotice.essentialPreferences: Language, interface mode, bubble color, onboarding and hint state, break statistics, consent choices and similar preferences are stored locally in the browser. Short-lived interface state is also stored in session storage.
privacyNotice.essentialRooms: The service stores room details, creator information, activity timestamps and aggregate visitor and bubble counters needed to operate room listings and multiplayer activity.
privacyNotice.analyticsDetails: Only after you enable usage analytics, Bubbles loads Google Analytics and sends page paths without query strings or fragments, plus limited feature events such as bubble size, popping, sharing and bounded error categories. Room names, display names, OAuth codes, raw error messages and stack traces are not included in these analytics events. Disabling analytics stops future analytics calls from the app and removes its loader from the page.
privacyNotice.advertisingAvailable: This build makes the advertising choice available. Google AdSense loads only after you enable advertising. The deployment must integrate a Google-certified consent platform wherever Google requires one before this build flag is enabled.
privacyNotice.advertisingUnavailable: Google AdSense is disabled in this build. Its script and ad slots are not loaded.
privacyNotice.googleServices: When enabled, Google processes optional-service data under the
privacyNotice.controlsDefault: Optional analytics and advertising are denied before you make a choice. Advertising also requires an explicit deployment build flag.
privacyNotice.controlsRevisit: Use the persistent Privacy button on any Bubbles page to review or change your choices.
privacyNotice.controlsRevoke: Turning off analytics sends a denied consent signal, prevents future app analytics calls and makes a best-effort attempt to remove _ga cookies accessible to this host. It cannot retract data already processed. Turning off advertising removes its script and slots from the current app, but likewise cannot retract previously processed data.
privacyNotice.controlsStorage: You can clear this site's browser data to remove locally stored choices, tokens and preferences. Doing so does not itself remove information already stored by the service or an optional provider.
privacyNotice.reviewNote: This page describes behavior implemented in this build and is not a substitute for deployment-specific legal review, especially before advertising is enabled.
